na3fbe2f4d9.headline: Why the tanker dispute is so dangerous
na3fbe2f4d9.summary: Following the detention of a British tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, Iran has escalated threats, increasing conflict risk in the strategically vital 50-kilometer-wide strait.
na3fbe2f4d9.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a critical chokepoint for global oil shipments; disruptions can impact energy prices and geopolitical risk premiums.
na3fbe2f4d9.why_moved: Escalation in tanker disputes raises risk of supply disruptions, causing oil prices to rise.
